```{r}
# Load packages

library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
fig_dir <- here("figures")
ensure_dir(fig_dir)

genome_id_col <- "Isolate" # column that groups contigs into genomes
n_perm <- 10000 # number of permutations
fdr_cutoff <- 0.025
set.seed(42) # reproducibility
```

```{r palette}
# Okabe-Ito based colour-blind friendly palette, used by both figures
mechanism_colours <- c(
  "Abi/Cell Death"          = "#D55E00",
  "Nucleic Acid Targeting"    = "#0072B2",
  "Other/Mixed"             = "#009E73",
  "DNA/RNA Modification"    = "#F0E442",
  "Uncharacterized"           = "#999999"
)

mechanism_levels <- names(mechanism_colours)
```

# 1. Permutation test


```{r prepare-data}

df <- read_metadata("metadata_updated_ecoli_systems_detail.csv") %>%
  filter(!is.na(type)) %>% # keep rows with a defense system
  mutate(
    Type   = tolower(Type), # 'plasmid' / 'chromosome'
    Genome = .data[[genome_id_col]] # explicit genome column
  )

annotations <- read_metadata("classification_final.csv") %>% 
select(system, mechanism_category, mechanism_subcategory)

# Collapse to one record per Contig x system family
by_contig <- df %>%
  select(Genome, Contig, Type, type) %>%
  distinct()

# Observed counts per family
obs_counts <- by_contig %>%
  group_by(type) %>%
  summarise(
    n_plasmid = sum(Type == "plasmid"),
    n_total   = n(),
    .groups   = "drop"
  )

families <- obs_counts$type
pi_bar   <- mean(by_contig$Type == "plasmid")   # overall plasmid share
```

```{r permutation}
perm_matrix <- matrix(
  0L,
  nrow = length(families), ncol = n_perm,
  dimnames = list(families, NULL)
)

pb <- progress_bar$new(
  total = n_perm, clear = FALSE,
  format = "  Permuting [:bar] :percent eta: :eta"
)

for (i in seq_len(n_perm)) {
  permuted <- by_contig %>%
    group_by(Genome) %>%
    mutate(Type_perm = sample(Type, size = n(), replace = FALSE)) %>%
    ungroup()

  perm_counts <- permuted %>%
    group_by(type) %>%
    summarise(n_plasmid = sum(Type_perm == "plasmid"), .groups = "drop")

  perm_matrix[perm_counts$type, i] <- perm_counts$n_plasmid
  pb$tick()
}

# Make sure perm_matrix row order matches obs_counts row order
perm_matrix <- perm_matrix[families, , drop = FALSE]
```

# 2. Helper functions

All shared logic lives here so the two figures (and the supplementary table) call
the same code paths.

```{r helpers}
# 2a. Compute enrichment results for one direction
# direction = "plasmid"  -> p_over: P(perm >= obs)
# direction = "chromosome" -> p_under: P(perm <= obs)
compute_enrichment <- function(obs_counts, perm_matrix, pi_bar,
                               direction = c("plasmid", "chromosome"),
                               fdr_cutoff = 0.025) {
  direction <- match.arg(direction)

  if (direction == "plasmid") {
    p_val <- (rowSums(perm_matrix >= obs_counts$n_plasmid) + 1) / (ncol(perm_matrix) + 1)
  } else {
    p_val <- (rowSums(perm_matrix <= obs_counts$n_plasmid) + 1) / (ncol(perm_matrix) + 1)
  }
  q_BH <- p.adjust(p_val, method = "BH")

  out <- obs_counts %>%
    mutate(
      p_val     = p_val[type],
      q_BH      = q_BH[type],
      sig_BH    = q_BH < fdr_cutoff
    )

  if (direction == "plasmid") {
    out <- out %>%
      mutate(
        obs_prop     = n_plasmid / n_total,
        expected     = n_total * pi_bar,
        diff         = n_plasmid - expected
      )
  } else {
    out <- out %>%
      mutate(
        n_chr        = n_total - n_plasmid,
        obs_prop     = n_chr / n_total,
        expected     = n_total * (1 - pi_bar),
        diff         = n_chr - expected
      )
  }
  out
}

# 2b. Add mechanism annotations + coloured y-axis labels
annotate_results <- function(results, annotations, mechanism_colours,
                             mechanism_levels) {
  results %>%
    left_join(annotations, by = c("type" = "system")) %>%
    mutate(
      mechanism_category = replace_na(mechanism_category, "Uncharacterized"),
      mechanism_category = factor(mechanism_category, levels = mechanism_levels),
      coloured_label = glue(
        "<span style='color:{mechanism_colours[as.character(mechanism_category)]}'>",
        "<b>{type}</b></span>"
      )
    )
}

# 2c. Shared theme
theme_enrichment <- function(base_size = 12) {
  theme_bw(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y   = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor     = element_blank(),
      plot.title           = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle        = element_text(size = 10, colour = "grey40"),
      axis.text.y          = element_markdown(size = 10),
      legend.title         = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
      legend.text          = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.position      = "bottom",
      legend.justification = "center"
    )
}

# 2d. Panel A: proportion dot plot
plot_proportion <- function(tbl, vline_x, title, subtitle, x_lab,
                            mechanism_colours) {
  ggplot(tbl, aes(x = obs_prop,
                  y = fct_reorder(coloured_label, obs_prop),
                  colour = mechanism_category)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = vline_x, linetype = "dashed",
               linewidth = 0.4, colour = "grey40") +
    geom_point(size = 3, show.legend = TRUE) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = mechanism_colours,
                        name   = "Defense mechanism", drop = FALSE) +
    labs(title = title, subtitle = subtitle, x = x_lab, y = NULL) +
    theme_enrichment() +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 2, override.aes = list(size = 4)))
}

# 2e. Panel B: excess count bar plot
plot_excess <- function(tbl, title, subtitle, x_lab, mechanism_colours) {
  ggplot(tbl, aes(x = diff,
                  y = fct_reorder(coloured_label, diff),
                  fill = mechanism_category)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7, show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = mechanism_colours,
                      name   = "Defense mechanism", drop = FALSE) +
    labs(title = title, subtitle = subtitle, x = x_lab, y = NULL) +
    theme_enrichment() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
}

# 2f. Combine the two panels with one shared legend
# NB: uses plot_layout(guides = "collect") only. Avoids the `&.gg` /
# `&.patchwork` operator which fails on some ggplot2/patchwork combinations
# (Error: Can't find method for generic `&(e1, e2)`).
combine_panels <- function(p_left, p_right) {
  (p_left + p_right) +
    plot_layout(ncol = 2, guides = "collect") +
    plot_annotation(theme = theme(legend.position = "bottom"))
}
```


# 3. Figure 2 - Plasmid-enriched defense systems

```{r figure-2, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 8}
results_plas <- compute_enrichment(
  obs_counts, perm_matrix, pi_bar,
  direction = "plasmid", fdr_cutoff = fdr_cutoff
)

plas_tbl <- results_plas %>%
  filter(sig_BH) %>%
  annotate_results(annotations, mechanism_colours, mechanism_levels)

plot_prop_plas <- plot_proportion(
  plas_tbl,
  vline_x  = pi_bar,
  title    = "A. Plasmid-enriched defense systems",
  subtitle = sprintf("BH-significant families (FDR < %g)", fdr_cutoff),
  x_lab    = "Proportion of occurrences on plasmids",
  mechanism_colours = mechanism_colours
)

plot_diff_plas <- plot_excess(
  plas_tbl,
  title    = "B. Excess plasmid occurrences (observed − expected)",
  subtitle = "BH-significant families only",
  x_lab    = "Excess plasmid count",
  mechanism_colours = mechanism_colours
)

fig2 <- combine_panels(plot_prop_plas, plot_diff_plas)
fig2

ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "fig2_plasmid_enriched_annotated2.png"),
       fig2, width = 12, height = 8, units = "in", dpi = 300)

```
# 4. Supplementary Figure S6 — Chromosome-enriched defense systems

```{r figure-s6, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 8}
results_chr <- compute_enrichment(
  obs_counts, perm_matrix, pi_bar,
  direction = "chromosome", fdr_cutoff = fdr_cutoff
)

chr_tbl <- results_chr %>%
  filter(sig_BH) %>%
  annotate_results(annotations, mechanism_colours, mechanism_levels)

plot_prop_chr <- plot_proportion(
  chr_tbl,
  vline_x  = 1 - pi_bar,
  title    = "A. Chromosome-enriched defense systems",
  subtitle = sprintf("BH-significant families (FDR < %g)", fdr_cutoff),
  x_lab    = "Proportion of occurrences on chromosomes",
  mechanism_colours = mechanism_colours
)

plot_diff_chr <- plot_excess(
  chr_tbl,
  title    = "B. Excess chromosome occurrences (observed − expected)",
  subtitle = "BH-significant families only",
  x_lab    = "Excess chromosome count",
  mechanism_colours = mechanism_colours
)

figS6 <- combine_panels(plot_prop_chr, plot_diff_chr)
figS6

ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "figS6_chromosome_enriched_annotated2.png"),
       figS6, width = 14, height = 10, units = "in", dpi = 400)
```

# 5. Supplementary File 1: Permutation test summary per defense-system family

```{r}


## Ensuring row order in perm_matrix matches obs_counts
families <- obs_counts$type
### If necessary, reordering perm_matrix rows (will no-op if already aligned)
perm_matrix <- perm_matrix[families, , drop = FALSE]

## empirical p-values
## One-sided plasmid enrichment (observed >= permuted)
obs_plas_vec <- obs_counts$n_plasmid
names(obs_plas_vec) <- families

p_plas <- (rowSums(perm_matrix >= obs_plas_vec) + 1) / (n_perm + 1)
## One-sided chromosome enrichment (observed <= permuted plasmid count)
## i.e., more on chromosome than expected corresponds to fewer plasmid counts.
p_chr <- (rowSums(perm_matrix <= obs_plas_vec) + 1) / (n_perm + 1)

## FDR corrections
q_plas_BH <- p.adjust(p_plas, method = "BH")
q_plas_BY <- p.adjust(p_plas, method = "BY")
q_chr_BH <- p.adjust(p_chr, method = "BH")
q_chr_BY <- p.adjust(p_chr, method = "BY")

## assemble table
supp_table <- obs_counts %>%
  mutate(
    n_chr = n_total - n_plasmid,
    expected_plas = n_total * pi_bar,
    expected_chr = n_total * (1 - pi_bar),
    plasmid_stat = n_plasmid - expected_plas, # obs − exp plasmid
    chromosome_stat = n_chr - expected_chr, # obs − exp chrom
    plasmid_p = p_plas[type],
    plasmid_q_BH = q_plas_BH[type],
    plasmid_q_BY = q_plas_BY[type],
    chromosome_p = p_chr[type],
    chromosome_q_BH = q_chr_BH[type],
    chromosome_q_BY = q_chr_BY[type]
  ) %>%
  rename(
    PDS_system = type,
    total_n = n_total,
    plasmid_n = n_plasmid,
    chromosome_n = n_chr
  ) %>%
  select(
    PDS_system,
    total_n,
    plasmid_n,
    chromosome_n,
    plasmid_stat,
    plasmid_p,
    plasmid_q_BH,
    chromosome_stat,
    chromosome_p,
    chromosome_q_BH,
    plasmid_q_BY,
    chromosome_q_BY
  ) %>%
  arrange(plasmid_p, chromosome_p)


## Save and check the table
write_csv(supp_table, file.path(fig_dir, "Supplementary_File_1.csv")) 

supp_table %>% 
summarise( 
plasmid_BH = sum(plasmid_q_BH < fdr_cutoff), 
plasmid_BY = sum(plasmid_q_BY < fdr_cutoff), 
chromosome_BH = sum(chromosome_q_BH < fdr_cutoff), 
chromosome_BY = sum(chromosome_q_BY < fdr_cutoff) )

```
